entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, my ID is 301. How can I help you today?
Hi... Isaac? I hope you can help. I ordered a helmet and I think I need to send it back. I'm just so confused by the website, I'm not sure if I'm doing it right.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the helmet or more of a preference?

Oh, um, a preference, I guess? The color isn't what I expected from the pictures online. And now I'm second-guessing the whole thing, wondering about its safety features. The box is still unopened, I haven't even taken it out. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can absolutely help with that. No problem at all. Let me just pull up your account. Could I get your email address or the order number?
Oh, thank you. My email is confused.customer@example.com.
Perfect, thank you. I'm pulling that up now... Okay, I see your order for the VeloFit Enduro Helmet, delivered on December 24th. You're well within the 90-day return period.
It's 90 days? Oh, I couldn't find that anywhere. I was so worried.

Yes, for standard gear like this helmet, it's 90 days. I've just processed the return authorization for you and sent a pre-paid shipping label to your email. Just print that out, attach it to the unopened box, and you can drop it off at any postal service.
Oh, wow. That's it? That's so easy. Thank you so much, Isaac. You've made this much less stressful.
You are very welcome. We'll process your full refund as soon as we receive the item. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you again!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
